description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaPipeline callback functionality in the Rialto client, verifying that notifications for playback state, network state, and QoS are correctly forwarded to the registered client.

classes.name: RialtoClientMediaPipelineCallbackTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for testing the media pipeline callback notifications in the Rialto client.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment and creates the media pipeline.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up the test environment and destroys the media pipeline.

methods.name: NotifyPlaybackState
methods.description: Test that playback state notifications are forwarded to the client.

methods.name: NotifyNetworkState
methods.description: Test that network state notifications are forwarded to the client.

methods.name: NotifyQos
methods.description: Test that QoS notifications are forwarded to the client.
